notes.title: Fix game issues
notes.content:
Unlimited:
1. The golden bell cover has not turned gray after use
2. The horizontal energy bar disappears and causes damage
Surround:
The second blood medicine item will disappear
2. Death can still be drunk with blood
Dungeons:
1. The first level is missing
2. The close button for the image guide cannot be turned off
3. Equipment cannot be picked up next to the crossbow
4. Phantom skill interrupted
极乐空间:
1. When carrying rotten items with pet eggs, they will disappear
2. The fourth item on the right side of the synthesis table cannot be fully introduced
3. The fourth one on the right side of the store cannot be fully introduced
4. The backpack is blocked by the financial UI
5 synthesis algorithms have problems, the probability is too low
6. Store items are prohibited from being dragged
